notes.title: Love Relaxation Release Date Is Coming!!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Love Relaxation will be released on February 24, 2025!

Since the demo version was released, we have been working hard on various fixes and adjustments to provide a better experience for our players.

If you're interested, feel free to download the demo and give it a try!
